title: ～だけでなく — not only ～ but also ～
summary: Adds another item or fact to the first: “not only ～ but also ～.” It attaches to nouns, and to verbs and adjectives in the plain form. The second half often has も, さえ or まで.

patterns.form: 名詞 ＋ だけでなく、～も
patterns.gloss: 子どもだけでなく、大人にも (not only children but also adults)

patterns.form: 普通形（な形容詞は〜な） ＋ だけでなく、～も
patterns.gloss: 安いだけでなく、品物もいい

body.p: The first half is limited to the obvious or basic point, and the second half adds a surprise or a bigger point: 安いだけでなく品物もいい. The pair is almost always completed by も in the second half.

body.h: Compared with ばかりでなく
body.p: だけでなく is neutral and used in both speech and writing. ばかりでなく is a bit more formal. 〜のみならず is the most formal written form. All of them express the same idea of adding more.

examples.ja: この店（みせ）は安（やす）いだけでなく、品物（しなもの）もいい。
examples.romaji: Kono mise wa yasui dake de naku, shinamono mo ii.
examples.tr: This shop is not only cheap but also has good goods.

examples.ja: この公園（こうえん）は子（こ）どもだけでなく、大人（おとな）にも人気（にんき）がある。
examples.romaji: Kono kōen wa kodomo dake de naku, otona ni mo ninki ga aru.
examples.tr: This park is popular not only with children but also with adults.

examples.ja: 彼（かれ）は約束（やくそく）を守（まも）るだけでなく、いつも早（はや）めに来（く）る。
examples.romaji: Kare wa yakusoku o mamoru dake de naku, itsumo hayame ni kuru.
examples.tr: He not only keeps his promises but also always arrives early.

pitfalls: Keep the second half in the same direction as the first. Do not add something contrary after it.
A particle goes after だけ in the first half if needed: 子どもだけでなく、大人にも.
